lua: nova.grass(); CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); T = require('lib.testkit'); LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov, tx, tz) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = W.height(v.x, v.z); local ax, _, az = v:to_world(tx or 0, 0, tz or 0); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, ax, g + (ty or 0.5), az, fov or 30 } end; PUT = function(x, z, h, steer) local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(x, z, h); v.steer = steer or 0; local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = x + 12, z + 12 end; IN_VAN = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(x, z, h); local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.reset(h) end
